SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sale_amount), 0) FROM fin_sale_record WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND sale_date >= #{startDate} AND sale_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(payment_amount), 0) FROM fin_sale_payment WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND payment_date >= #{startDate} AND payment_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(expense_amount), 0) FROM fin_expense WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '1'
AND expense_date >= #{startDate} AND expense_date <= #{endDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_review_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_review_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND severity = 'HIGH'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_review_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 'DONE' AND update_time >= #{startDate} AND update_time <= #{endDate}

SELECT task_type AS taskType, title, reason, suggestion, target_route AS targetRoute, impact_amount AS impactAmount, dept_id AS deptId FROM finance_review_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND severity = 'HIGH'
ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT dept_name FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id = #{deptId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = #{tableName}
